about: Smoke test of the Goudy-on-ivory bookends (src/templates/Bookend.tsx) on Kun, week 1's first post. The short is out/series/02-kun/short.mp4 as rendered, copied to public/local/bookend/ by scripts/bookend.mjs. The flicker in lands as the hook turns bold (1.5 s); the flicker out comes once the end card's site line is up. Variant: the close in the app icon's layout (the user, 2026-09-30: 'can we try just replacing with the appicon layout directly and see how it looks?').
hook: Tired of always having to lead?
